title: 第2章 八卦-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    吴姜赶忙摇了摇头，把那股怪异感甩得一干二净，只当是方才殿内香火太浓熏得眼花。

    等着爷爷叨咕完了，吴姜赶紧上前搀扶起老爷子，又陪着他到殿外的焚金炉旁，把竹篮里的元宝一一添进去。看着火苗舔舐着金纸噼啪作响，这场折腾人的上香仪式才算彻底落幕。

    感觉也没干多少事，爷孙俩骑车到家的时候，已经接近中午了。

    吴姜一进家门就直奔冰箱，反手掏出一瓶冰镇快乐水，拧开瓶盖仰头就是吨吨吨的几大口，舒服的叫了一声：“爽啊！”

    九月的苍名县，正是最热的时候，要不是为了老爷子，吴姜真的不想出门，遭老罪了。

    “小姜，中午饭简单做点就行，不用费那劲搞复杂了。”

    老爷子从洗手间里洗脸出来，对着客厅喊了一声。

    吴姜正瘫在沙发上回味着肥宅快乐水的惬意，听见这话顿时僵住，脸上的笑意淡了大半。

    “啊？又让我做啊？”吴姜一脸懵圈，语气里满是不情愿，心里嘀咕着怎么做饭的活儿又落到自己头上了。

    老爷子立马板起脸，语气带着几分理直气壮：“怎么？爷爷都这把年纪了，出去折腾大半天，你好意思让我下厨？”

    得，吴姜心里门儿清，再跟老爷子掰扯下去，他准得开启卖老模式，赶紧不情不愿地应了声“知道了”。

    心里却在忍不住疯狂吐槽，糟老头子坏滴很，明明才七十出头，身体硬朗的不得了，晚上出去跳广场舞的时候，不知道跳的多起劲，得亏奶奶走得早，不然看你还能不能嚣张的起来。

    吴姜也图省事，炒了一个番茄鸡蛋当做卤子，又另外下了一锅面条，用冷水一过，简单却美味的过水捞面条就好了。

    爷孙俩一人一瓶冰啤酒，就着几瓣大蒜，呼噜呼噜地往嘴里扒拉面条，吃得那叫一个香。

    吴姜为了避免洗碗，吃饭的动作都比以前加快了许多，随着最后一瓣大蒜下肚，他胡乱用纸巾擦了擦嘴，把碗往前一推，喊了一声：“我吃好了，回屋睡觉去了！”

    说完，也不等爷爷应声，麻溜的就跑回了自己的房间。

    “这臭小子......”老爷子看着他溜得飞快的背影，又气又笑，哪儿能不明白他的小心思。

    成功躲过洗碗大业的吴姜躺在床上，沾沾自喜地摸着肚子，为自己的机智暗暗点赞。

    他随手点开手机小说翻了几页，连日头晒加折腾半天的困意涌了上来，眼皮越来越沉。

    再次睁开眼时，已经下午三点了。

    吴姜伸着懒腰走出房间，屋子里静悄悄的，显然老爷子已经出门了。

    他也不以为意，不用想也知道，爷爷准是找那几个同样退休的老头儿下棋去了。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Wu Jiang quickly shook his head to get rid of the strange feeling, thinking it was just because the incense in the palace was too strong and dazzled his eyes.

Waiting for his grandfather to finish mumbling, Wu Jiang hurriedly stepped forward to help the old man up, then accompanied him to the gold-burning furnace outside the hall, and added the ingots in the bamboo basket one by one.Seeing the flames licking and crackling the gold paper, this torturous incense ceremony finally came to an end.

It felt like they didn’t do much. When the grandfather and grandson arrived home by bike, it was already close to noon.

As soon as Wu Jiang entered the house, he went straight to the refrigerator, took out a bottle of ice-cold happy water, unscrewed the cap, looked up and took a few big mouthfuls, and exclaimed comfortably: "It feels so good!"

September in Cangming County is the hottest time. If it weren’t for the old man, Wu Jiang would really not want to go out and suffer the consequences.

"Xiao Jiang, just make something simple for lunch, don't bother to make it complicated."

The old man came out of the bathroom to wash his face and shouted into the living room.

Wu Jiang was slumped on the sofa, reminiscing about the comfort of Feizhai Happy Water. When he heard these words, he suddenly froze, and the smile on his face faded by half.

"Ah? Are you asking me to do it again?" Wu Jiang looked confused and his tone was full of reluctance, muttering in his heart that the cooking job fell on him again.

The old man immediately put on a serious face and said with a somewhat confident tone: "What? Grandpa is already this old and has been out for a long time. Are you embarrassed to let me cook?"

but , wu jiang was very clear in his heart.

But in my heart I couldn’t help but complain crazily. The old man is very bad. He is only in his early seventies and has a very strong body. When he went out to dance in the square at night, he didn’t know how hard he danced. It was thanks to his grandma that he left early, otherwise I would like to see if you could still be arrogant.

Wu Jiang also tried to save trouble, frying a tomato and egg as a marinade, and added another pot of noodles, and ran them through cold water. It was a simple but delicious way to drain the noodles.

The grandfather and grandson each had a bottle of cold beer, a few cloves of garlic, and slurped noodles into their mouths. They ate deliciously.

In order to avoid washing the dishes, Wu Jiang ate much faster than before. As the last clove of garlic went down, he wiped his mouth with a paper towel, pushed the bowl forward, and shouted: "I'm done eating, I'm going back to the house to sleep!"

After saying that, without waiting for Grandpa to respond, he ran back to his room.

"This brat..." The old man looked at his fast running back and laughed angrily. How could he not understand his little thoughts.

Wu Jiang, who had successfully avoided the task of washing dishes, was lying on the bed, rubbing his belly smugly, and secretly praised his wit.

He casually clicked on the novel on his mobile phone and flipped through a few pages. The sleepiness of being exposed to the sun and tossing for a long time came to him, and his eyelids became heavier and heavier.

When I opened my eyes again, it was already three o'clock in the afternoon.

Wu Jiang stretched and walked out of the room. The room was quiet. It was obvious that the old man had already gone out.

He didn’t take it seriously. He knew without thinking that his grandfather must have gone to play chess with those old men who were also retired.
